description: Retired carrier profile IDs (rule round 45, item 1). A profile ID is assigned once and kept; it is not recomputed from the match set. When a profile's SIMs change and the ID cannot carry over, the old ID is retired, never reused, and listed here with the profile or profiles a SIM of its old rule matches now, computed by tools/profile_ids.py, never mapped by hand. kind: replaced (one new profile took its SIMs), split (several new profiles took them), merge (one new profile took the SIMs of several retired IDs), withdrawn (no new profile took them; to names where they fall now, if anywhere). An alias is a redirect for links and saved reports; it never carries a value. continued lists the live IDs whose match set is no longer the one they were issued for: the same SIMs written differently (same_sims), or an accepted continuity entry (continuity_entry).
